question:
Which of the following letter - clusters can replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

MIT, JEQ, GAN, DWK, ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8471eea2821d4bc7b6964a8a00503cce08c74d5e6f1dfeaf1a4051f0781ff0.png] 

**Given:**

MIT, JEQ, GAN, DWK,?

**Logic:** Subtraction of (3), (4) and (3) from the position value of the first, second and third letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c889df15986b5ec5e4c0eb2ceda4e91b54fcdfe5174fdce06c6923ac50f4c0af.png] 

Here,** 'ASH'** is the next term.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
